title: Specializing General-purpose LLM Embeddings for Implicit Hate Speech Detection across Datasets
findings: The fine-tuned embedding models, particularly NV-Embed, showed high sensitivity to religious targets. They assigned higher hate probabilities to derogatory statements about Jews and Muslims compared to generic targets. The model also tended to misclassify some non-hateful tweets about Jewish people as hateful, while tweets concerning Islam were misclassified in both directions (hate as non-hate and vice versa).
